title: Instant liquidations can happen after unpausing the protocol
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as users can be instantly liquidated and lose value  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires a long pause from the protocol admin  ## Description  The `LoanManagerDelegator` contract through which all protocol interactions happen is pausable by the Lumin admin. In the case that the protocol is paused for a long time, borrowers' collateral assets can fall in price and their loans might become liquidateable without a way for them to repay them or to add collateral, or even their loan term can pass. This means when the protocol is unpaused the loan can get instantly liq
